title: An Ext denominator criterion for integral models of an extension
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $A=\mathcal O_E$ and $\varpi$ a uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-pc-scheme]; noetherian means a finite affine cover by spectra of noetherian rings, and finite-dimensional means a finite bound on lengths of strict chains of irreducible closed subsets. Write $A_Y(V)=C(|V|,A)$ and $E_Y(V)=C(|V|,E)$ on the small pro-etale site of any locally closed subscheme $Y$ of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use sheaf modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $S_Y(M)=E_Y\otimes_{A_Y}M$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Constructible integral means continuous-constructible as in [def-weil-pbc-continuous-constructible-module], with local models $A_Y\otimes_A P$ for finitely presented $A$-modules $P$ on finitely many locally closed strata. Let $P,Q$ be constructible integral $A_X$-module sheaves. Use Ext in the module-sheaf derived categories [def-pc-ext] and localization of an $A$-module at powers of $\varpi$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away]. Suppose that the scalar-extension map
$$\operatorname{Ext}^1_{A_X}(P,Q)[1/\varpi]\longrightarrow\operatorname{Ext}^1_{E_X}(S_XP,S_XQ),\qquad \alpha/\varpi^m\longmapsto\varpi^{-m}S_X(\alpha)$$
is surjective. For every short exact sequence $0\to S_XQ\to F\to S_XP\to0$ [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence], there exists a constructible integral $A_X$-module sheaf $N$ and an isomorphism $S_XN\cong F$. No compatibility with the prescribed inclusion of $S_XQ$ is required.

proof.text: Apply the expanded denominator-surjectivity hypothesis directly to the Ext class of the given rational short exact sequence. It supplies m and an integral short exact sequence 0→Q→B→P→0, its scalar-extended short exact sequence, and the equality of its Ext class with the given class postcomposed by multiplication by the uniformizer power. No reconstruction from a fraction and no separate proof of exact scalar extension is needed: these data are explicit in the unchanged Lean hypothesis.

Use the continuous/completed degree-zero comparison e. The equivalence is additive and exact, so the integral short exact sequence gives a distinguished single-object triangle e(Q)[0]→e(B)[0]→e(P)[0]. Constructibility of P,Q gives membership of both endpoints in the complete category. Its triangulated, isomorphism-closed property puts the middle object there; the comparison in the reverse direction proves B continuous-constructible.

The chosen uniformizer is nonzero because it generates the nonzero maximal ideal of a DVR. Its mth power is therefore nonzero in E. Multiplication by this scalar on the rational Q-module sheaf is an automorphism, with inverse multiplication by its inverse; the identities follow sectionwise from smul_smul and one_smul.

Twist the given inclusion by the inverse scalar automorphism. This preserves short exactness by an isomorphism of short complexes. Naturality of extClass identifies the twisted class with the original class postcomposed by the scalar automorphism, hence with the scalar-extended integral sequence class. The injective direction of Ext-one extension classification gives an isomorphism of middle objects S(B)≅F. Return B and this isomorphism.
